related.title: CubeSat 小衛星系統工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學新鮮度目標 70 min 不能只用平均 45 min 判定；新方案最壞接近 75 min 仍可能逾時。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A 70 min teaching freshness target cannot be accepted from mean 45 min; the new worst case near 75 min can still miss it. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 建立一個軌道週期的能量帳，區分平均功率與日照／地影排程。
related.differenceEn: Build an orbit energy ledger separating average power from sunlit/eclipsed scheduling.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學接收間隔 90 min、處理及傳送固定 15 min，忽略失敗重送。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：平均延遲=90/2+15。 結果約 60 min。規律間隔 T 的下一站等待在均勻相位假設下平均 T/2；最壞近 T，與處理延遲相加。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學週期可收集 90 Wh，平台、通訊及載荷合計需求 80 Wh。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：M=(90−80)/80。 結果約 0.125 fraction。能量裕度=(可收集能量−需求)/需求；必須對同一週期，另驗瞬間功率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching contact interval is 90 min plus 15 min fixed processing/transmission, ignoring retries. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Mean latency=90/2+15. Result ≈ 60 min. With regular contact interval T and uniform phase, mean waiting is T/2 and worst case approaches T; add processing latency.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. A teaching cycle harvests 90 Wh against 80 Wh total bus, communication and payload demand. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: M=(90−80)/80. Result ≈ 0.125 fraction. Energy margin=(harvest−demand)/demand must use one common cycle, with a separate peak-power check.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 航太任務系統需求管理
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：教學新鮮度目標 70 min 不能只用平均 45 min 判定；新方案最壞接近 75 min 仍可能逾時。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A 70 min teaching freshness target cannot be accepted from mean 45 min; the new worst case near 75 min can still miss it. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 建立需求驗證矩陣，分辨測試完成率、通過率與關鍵需求狀態。
related.differenceEn: Build a requirements-verification matrix separating execution coverage, pass rate and critical-requirement status.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學接收間隔 90 min、處理及傳送固定 15 min，忽略失敗重送。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：平均延遲=90/2+15。 結果約 60 min。規律間隔 T 的下一站等待在均勻相位假設下平均 T/2；最壞近 T，與處理延遲相加。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學基線 20 條需求，17 條有合格證據，2 條未測，1 條關鍵需求失敗。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：通過覆蓋率=17/20。 結果約 0.85 fraction。通過覆蓋率=已有合格證據的需求數/基線需求數；平均比例不能覆蓋一項關鍵失敗。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching contact interval is 90 min plus 15 min fixed processing/transmission, ignoring retries. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Mean latency=90/2+15. Result ≈ 60 min. With regular contact interval T and uniform phase, mean waiting is T/2 and worst case approaches T; add processing latency.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching baseline has 20 requirements: 17 with acceptable evidence, two untested and one failed critical requirement. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Pass coverage=17/20. Result ≈ 0.85 fraction. Pass coverage=baseline requirements with acceptable evidence/total baseline requirements; an average cannot override a critical failure.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
